taste.name: No Brand Accent
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a dark page where a brand hue would be the usual way to mark the primary action.
taste.decision: Chose a white pill button on near-black (#08090A) over a saturated brand-color CTA and accent links.
taste.reason: The mock-ups contain colored status icons and labels, which are the product's own signals. A page-level accent would compete with them.
evidence: No chromatic color in nav, links or buttons
#08090A is 64.1% and #0F1011 is 20.7% of background area
accent candidates are all grays and white

taste.name: Lightness Ladder
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a large amount of small text on a dark surface where bold weights would smear.
taste.decision: Chose five steps of text lightness and 400/510 weights over larger sizes and heavier weights to rank information.
taste.reason: On dark backgrounds, bolder type blooms and sizes inflate the panels. Lightness lets a reader skip dim meta text without it being hidden.

taste.name: Hairlines, Not Shadows
taste.trigger: When the designers faced stacking panels that are only a few percent lighter than the page.
taste.decision: Chose 0.5-1px white-alpha inset rings, with one soft drop shadow for floating agent panels, over layered drop shadows on every card.
taste.reason: A black shadow is invisible on #08090A, so the edge has to come from light. Only the floating panel overlaps content, so only it gets a shadow.
evidence: all shadows single-layer, pure black or white-alpha

taste.name: Product as Imagery
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a marketing page that would normally carry illustrations, stock photos or abstract gradients.
taste.decision: Chose cropped, near-live UI mock-ups over illustration or photography.
taste.reason: The buyer is judging a tool they will live in for hours. A screenshot with real issue IDs and mono chips shows density and speed better than a picture of a team.
evidence: every sampled image is a screenshot or a 1:1 avatar/logo
Berkeley Mono x264 for ENG-2844-style IDs
~150-224px whitespace between sections, one hairline above the footer
